units.source_text: 阿笑的耳根都染上了红潮，这红色又一点点朝她的胸部、腹部爬来。

en.t: A flush spread all the way to the roots of Axiao's ears, and that redness crept little by little toward her chest and belly.

units.source_text: 阿泷望着这天仙般美丽的血色，不禁产生一股无以名状的忌妒，以及难以忍受的快感。

en.t: As Along gazed at that heavenly, beautiful color of blood, an indescribable jealousy and an unbearable pleasure welled up in her despite herself.
